summary_md: **Itaru Tomita / 冨田到 ([@itarutomy](https://x.com/itarutomy/status/2116115400668680298))** explains *Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs* ([arXiv 2610.20832](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.20832v1)) by Kriz et al.: AR-BED trains reasoning models with expected information gain as reward in 20-questions, beating baselines on unseen categories while merely enabling reasoning lowered accuracy; he notes biases in the candidate set and no real-patient validation.

referenced_urls.title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs

relevance: Training agents to ask informative questions.

media.description: Paper figure 1 charts of success rate by turn across animals, plants, celebrities and countries.
